llm_recommendations.reason_for_recommendation: Robust Q1 FY27 performance with 15.9% year-on-year increase in profit after tax, broad-based loan growth, stable margins, and oversubscribed USD 1 billion notes issuance signaling strong investor confidence. Bernstein upgraded to 'Outperform' with INR 1,800 target.

Jointly launched a new Gemini Experience Center (GEC) with Google Cloud to accelerate enterprise AI adoption. Indian IT services industry is poised for sharp recovery in 2026 fueled by AI demand. Company clarified no credible evidence of system or customer data breach.

Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) significantly reduced its holding by ₹10,229 crore in Q1 FY27. Stock declined below its 100-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA), indicating technical weakness. Broader headwinds in the Indian IT services sector from weak discretionary spending and global economic uncertainties.
Moderate intraday decline with subdued trading volumes. Minor negative development concerning its retail arm, Reliance Retail, due to an issue involving 'worms in sweet' at an outlet.

US subsidiary agreed to a $15.28 million settlement in antitrust litigation. The entire settlement amount has already been provided for in financial statements and is not expected to have a significant impact on financial position. Resolution removes legal uncertainty.
